skeleton.placeName: The Tomb of the Silent Margrave

knot.transgression: The Silent Margrave bound a procession by oath they could not break, so that someone would always go behind them.

motif.dangerLine: the barrow keeps its order, and you have joined the queue

prize.label: the crown worn first, and only once

bottomProblem.label: The Silent Margrave
bottomProblem.wantNow: to be first in all things
bottomProblem.failureState: is second now, and cannot bear it
bottomProblem.handledBy: giving them what they want, at a price

appeasement.move: stand aside and let it go ahead of you

factions.name: The Silent Host
factions.essence: still performing the ritual they were buried for

factions.name: the Barrow-Wardens
factions.essence: sealed this place and stayed to make sure

foreshadow.fragment: banners in sequence, each house a place further back
a herald's script with the order still marked
a door only one person may pass at a time, and only first
a name moved to the front by force, repeatedly
the crown worn first, and only once
a corridor that will not let two walk abreast

areas.name: The Outer Cut
cueFragments: the queue disturbed — three of the dead pushed aside

situation.doing: refusing, each of them, to go through a door second
situation.onArrival: they both look at you to break it
situation.because: neither may be seen to yield
situation.offer: rule between them and the loser attaches to you as a lesser

areas.truth: This is how the place was ordered, and it still is

decision.cue: banners in strict order, and one you could move
decision.cost: reordering them opens a way and insults everyone buried here

resolve.success: you reorder them correctly and a way opens
resolve.failure: you reorder wrongly and insult everyone buried here: +1 Bane
resolve.orElse: leave them: the way stays shut, one Turn to find another

clue.automatic: numbered flagstones, counting down — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, move its cue fragment into the next area so the motif still completes.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

areas.name: The Waiting Room
cueFragments: banners in sequence, each house a place further back
a rank-plate prised off and dropped, still shiny where it sat

situation.doing: passing through, unhurried, with you in its way
situation.onArrival: it does not stop or go round
situation.because: it has right of way and has had for three centuries
situation.offer: stand aside and be counted courteous; join it and be counted one of them

areas.truth: The office is still being performed, for someone who is no longer served by it

decision.cue: a corridor that will not let two walk abreast
decision.cost: whoever goes first meets whatever is there first

resolve.success: you settle the order and whoever leads meets what is there, ready
resolve.failure: you argue in the corridor and something arrives while you do
resolve.orElse: send one scout: slow, one Turn, and they are alone

temptation.cue: a herald's script with your name pencilled in
temptation.benefit: once, be announced as whatever you claim
temptation.standingDrawback: you must live up to it in front of the Host

clue.automatic: banners in sequence, each house a place further back — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, move its cue fragment into the next area so the motif still completes.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

areas.name: The Attendants' Row
cueFragments: a herald's script with the order still marked
someone has walked the corridor the wrong way, scuffing one side

situation.onArrival: they freeze, then offer you one
situation.because: they worked out the order is what keeps the doors shut
situation.offer: take a plate and go first anywhere — the Host will hate you for it

areas.truth: The office is still being performed, for someone who is no longer served by it

decision.cue: a door that opens only for the foremost of a party
decision.cost: someone must be named first, aloud, and the others must accept it

resolve.success: someone is named first, aloud, and the door opens for them
resolve.failure: the naming is disputed and the door reads that as no answer
resolve.orElse: let the barrow choose: it picks the loudest, and remembers

foes.name: Ghoul
foes.note: on a hit, a free Called Shot to freeze for a round

roster.avoid: the Ghoul goes for court dress first — send someone plain

temptation.cue: a rank-plate prised off something and pocketed
temptation.benefit: go first through any door the barrow guards
temptation.standingDrawback: going first is now expected of you

clue.automatic: a herald's script with the order still marked — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, move its cue fragment into the next area so the motif still completes.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

areas.name: The Middle Vault
cueFragments: a door only one person may pass at a time, and only first
a seat at the head of the hall dragged back, as if to sit in

situation.doing: waiting to pass a door, in strict order, not moving
situation.onArrival: the queue opens a gap at exactly your rank
situation.because: the first in line is waiting for someone who never arrived
situation.offer: take the gap and go with them; take the front and they will remember it

areas.truth: Here the want is explicit — the place asks something of whoever enters

decision.cue: a claim to settle: which of you the barrow should address
decision.cost: settling it opens the way; refusing to settle it does not

resolve.success: the claim is settled and the barrow addresses one of you from now on
resolve.failure: it is not settled, and the barrow keeps asking, in worse places
resolve.orElse: refuse to settle: the way on does not open

clue.automatic: a door only one person may pass at a time, and only first — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, move its cue fragment into the next area so the motif still completes.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

areas.name: The Lower Cut
cueFragments: a name moved to the front by force, repeatedly
a numbered flagstone lifted and not replaced

situation.occupant: one of the Host with a herald's staff
situation.doing: announcing arrivals to an empty stair
situation.onArrival: it announces you, inventing a rank
situation.because: the post requires arrivals and there have been none
situation.offer: accept the invented rank and the barrow will treat you as it

areas.truth: This is the damage the want did to those who had to satisfy it

decision.cue: a stair where the order of descent is visibly recorded
decision.cost: whoever goes last is remembered as having gone last

resolve.success: you settle the order before you descend and the record reads as a party, not a rabble
resolve.failure: you descend in a scramble: whoever is recorded last is treated as least by the Host from here
resolve.orElse: descend however you like and accept the record as it falls

clue.automatic: a name moved to the front by force, repeatedly — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, move its cue fragment into the next area so the motif still completes.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

areas.name: The Last Door
cueFragments: the crown worn first, and only once
banners pulled down and stacked without regard for order

situation.doing: reading out an order of precedence to an empty hall
situation.onArrival: it pauses and asks where you fall in it
situation.because: the list must be read in full before anyone may proceed
situation.offer: name your own place in the order and it will be honoured, exactly

areas.truth: The thing the whole barrow is arranged around is close

decision.cue: a queue of the dead, and a way to step round it
decision.cost: waiting costs two Turns; pushing in costs the Host's patience

resolve.success: you step round without breaking the order, and the Host allows it
resolve.failure: you push in: +1 Bane and the queue closes behind you
resolve.orElse: wait: two Turns, and the Host thinks better of you

foes.name: Wraith
foes.note: INCORPOREAL — chill touch ignores armour and drains 1 max Grit

roster.harmedBy: blessed, silvered or magical weapons ONLY
roster.avoid: it will take an appeasement over a fight every time

temptation.cue: a small crown, sized for someone who never grew
temptation.benefit: +1 die when others must defer to you
temptation.standingDrawback: you must be addressed correctly or lose the benefit

clue.automatic: the crown worn first, and only once — and it was done deliberately
clue.extra: [VANITY: Observation — 1 success] buys who did it, and roughly when

areas.failureCase: If they skip this, the ending opens with them holding nothing the bottom problem wants.

fallback.route: The Silent Host will receive anyone who behaves as a guest
fallback.cost: one Bane on the tab, and they will expect it again

ending.name: The Audience
cueFragments: a corridor that will not let two walk abreast
ending.question: "Who goes first?"

triggerGlossary.announced: entered somewhere grandly — the big doors, a shout, a herald
triggerGlossary.seenTwice: reflected, echoed or witnessed twice over in one place
triggerGlossary.loud: a raised voice, a broken door, steel on stone
triggerGlossary.lingering: stayed in one place longer than it takes to search it
triggerGlossary.disturbed: struck or moved something that had not moved in centuries
